phase1_leaf_result.part100_scope: Current GitHub repository id/node_id plus official Get-repository/global-node-ID/delete documentation and six constructed histories for delete/recreate, witness loss, proposal binding and same-incarnation rollback.
phase1_leaf_result.new_positive_evidence: Current repository node identity is a narrow incarnation discriminator: old-incarnation proposals that carry the prior node_id can be rejected against the current node_id before a repository-authoritative effect.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: Current repository identity is not a standalone rollback-proof freshness floor when both the trusted prior-incarnation witness and proposal binding were lost/rolled back with repository state; inspected GitHub documentation does not promise a monotonic repository generation across every delete/restore/recreate path.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A rollback-domain-independent sink-side minimum-generation/freshness witness that rejects stale generations without protected/admin setup, richer-mode/manual execution, external hosted coordination, or finite monthly/trial/paid quota.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only Part100's current repository metadata, three bounded official GitHub documentation surfaces and six constructed histories; no destructive repository deletion, no guarantee about undocumented restore identity semantics, and no generalization to arbitrary sinks.

continuation: Part101: execute exactly one bounded sink-side minimum-generation leaf. Model a stale proposal carrying {repository_node_id, generation, effect_id} against a current repository incarnation after delete/recreate and test whether any Chat-native authoritative sink available without protected/admin setup can atomically reject generation below a durable minimum while preserving idempotent retry. Compare repository-only CAS/current-node check, durable sink-local minimum-generation state, and missing/rolled-back sink floor. If no rollback-domain-independent sink floor exists without external hosted coordination or manual/protected setup, preserve that as the unresolved child rather than treating repository identity as sufficient.
